status: PLANNED_NOT_EXPORTED; metadata only; no GEE calls made

optical.cloud_metadata_field: Landsat CLOUD_COVER / S2 max member-granule cloudy_pixel_percent

NEAR_FULL_NOMINAL_TOLERANCE.trigger: only when no strict-full cloud-eligible autumn scene exists for the cell/sensor/year
NEAR_FULL_NOMINAL_TOLERANCE.fraction_basis: intersection_area / cell_polygon_area (EPSG:4326) against wrs2_china_coast_v0_1 nominal WRS-2 frames

post_export_gate.measure: share of landed export-grid pixels with QA_PIXEL fill bit clear
post_export_gate.on_fail: product marked GEOMETRY_FAIL and excluded from registered cell products

sentinel2_coverage.rule: an event qualifies only when the union of its same-datatake member MGRS tile polygons covers the cell; different dates are never merged

sentinel1.log_transform: identity (GEE S1_GRD is already sigma0 dB)

selection_policy.label_independent: selection never uses label overlap, label presence, or model performance of any kind

anchor_slots.note: Landsat 5 TM Collection 2 L2 where real eligible scenes exist
Landsat 5 TM preferred; Landsat 7 ETM+ is the only fallback when L5 has no eligible event (2000 is SLC-on for both)
S1 IW GRD VV/VH; one product per orbit pass; exact acquisition/event semantics required (operations began 2015)
S2A only after 2015-06-23; absent scenes are honest NO_SCENE, never fabricated
Landsat 8 OLI aligned with the three-product 2020 audit
S1 IW GRD VV/VH; ASC and DESC kept separate, never fused
S2 SR native 10 m; same-datatake tiles only, s2_scl_qa_v1_1
S1 anchor aligned with CMSA 2021 reference availability
S2 anchor aligned with CMSA 2021 reference availability
L8 2021 only where it adds a valid cloud-free observation

gee_index_rules.sentinel1: system:index = full S1 GRD product identifier
